title: Soul SMP
description: This Plugin Adds a Soul system that decrease when you die and increase when you kill someone.
body:
## Example Of Souls
![The Souls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8ea2912c1978bd0b56aff84d69538b2d8443de2.png)

### Soul System

This Plugin adds a neat **"Soul System"** that makes it so when you kill a player you gain a soul, and when you die you lose one. ~~Pretty original, huh?~~ You Start with 2 Souls.

### BY THE WAY
**if youre gonna use this on your smp, could you credit me? You dont have to, but it would make me happy to see my work.**

if you have any issues, pls contact me on the discord in the links.


### Soul Effects

but, when you have **more than 2,** you gain quirks. when you have 3 souls, you gain a speed boost. when you have 4 souls, you gain strength. when you have 5, you have 5 extra hearts. the maximum numbers of souls you can have is 5. you can change someones soul (only if you have admin) by using /soul set player number and /soul gui player. And when you have 0, you gain weakness and slowness. 

### Soul Item

**This Also Adds a Custom Item** that makes you gain a soul. A Soul Fragment. It is crafted by using 8 netherite ingots and 1 ominious trial key.
